entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A Centaur druid from the Krosan forest, emissary of the Krosan centaurs and pit fighter, murdered by the Cabal.

entities.name: Krosan forest
entities.description: A forest on Dominaria, home of the Krosan centaurs.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane containing the Krosan forest.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A barbarian warrior and pit fighter who became Seton's friend and pursued the Mirari.

entities.name: Thriss
entities.description: Sent Seton to Cabal City to investigate the magical disturbances.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: The place where magical disturbances were centered and Seton fought in the pits.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: The source of the magical disturbance and Kamahl's rage.

entities.name: Kirtar
entities.description: An aven commander who bore the Mirari and insanely attacked Krosa.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: An ambassador whose bodyguard was Turg.

entities.name: Turg
entities.description: Ambassador Laquatus' anurid bodyguard who nearly blinded Seton with acidic bile.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, stabbed by him and left in Seton's care, then abducted.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: Led the Cabal forces who murdered Seton and abducted Jeska.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: The faction whose forces pursued Kamahl.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: The battle over the Mirari in Krosa.

events.summary: Seton meets Kamahl in a pit fight and they become friends after defeating a dementia creature.
events.quote: the two became good friends after they teamed up to defeat a powerful dementia creature, and Kamahl saved the centaur's life

events.summary: Seton wrestles Turg but is nearly blinded by his bile and stays in Krosa to recover.
events.quote: Turg intentionally vomited in Seton's face, nearly blinding the centaur with his acidic bile.

events.summary: Kamahl stabs his sister Jeska in Mirari-induced rage and leaves her in Seton's care.
events.quote: he left his sister in Seton's care

events.summary: Cabal forces led by Braids murder Seton and abduct Jeska.
events.quote: he found that Seton had been murdered and Jeska abducted by the Cabal forces that had pursued him, led by Braids .

relations.note: Cabal forces led by Braids murdered him.
relations.quote: Seton had been murdered and Jeska abducted by the Cabal forces that had pursued him, led by Braids .
